# GlucoSolutions: full overview

> A needle-free glucose band for people with prediabetes. In development; waitlist open.

Site: https://www.glucosolutionsinc.com
Contact: tenzin@glucosolutions.ca

---

## Hero

**See what moves your blood sugar.**

A needle-free band for people with prediabetes. It follows your glucose through the skin and shows you which meals, walks, nights of sleep and stressful days are moving you back toward normal.

Call to action: Join the waitlist. We're inviting people in small groups, starting in Canada. iPhone first.

---

## Prediabetes is the stage you can still turn around

Your blood sugar is higher than it should be, but it isn't type 2. Most people leave that appointment with the advice to eat better, move more and check back in a few months. The advice is sound. What's missing is a way to tell which changes are working for you.

- 6.4 million Canadians were estimated to be living with prediabetes in 2025. (Diabetes Canada)
- More than half of people with prediabetes go on to develop type 2 within 8 to 10 years if nothing changes. (Diabetes Canada)
- 58% lower risk of type 2 for people who changed how they ate and moved, in the Diabetes Prevention Program. (New England Journal of Medicine, 2002)

---

## The advice is right. It just isn't specific to you.

The same bowl of rice can send one person's glucose climbing and barely move another's. What you eat first, a short walk, last night's sleep: each one changes the shape. Published studies show eating vegetables before carbohydrates (Shukla et al., Diabetes Care, 2015) and walking after meals (Buffey et al., Sports Medicine, 2022) both soften the post-meal rise.

---

## How it works

1. **Put it on.** A soft band that reads your wrist through the skin. No needles, no patches, nothing to replace. Charge it about once a week.
2. **Live the way you normally do.** Eat, move, work, sleep. The band follows your glucose in the background.
3. **See what moved you, and what to try next.** After a meal, a walk or a rough night the app shows whether you rose, held steady or settled, then gives one plain-English suggestion at a time: walk now, start with the vegetables, get to bed earlier.

---

## The band: light instead of needles

- How it reads: through the skin of the wrist, with no needles.
- What it shows: the direction of your glucose (rising, steady or settling), not an exact reading.
- Accuracy so far: about 80% of trends classified correctly in benchtop testing.
- Needles, patches, refills: none.
- Charging: about once a week.
- App: iPhone first, Android after.
- Status: in development.

Compared with a CGM: a CGM reads exact numbers through a filament under the skin and needs a new sensor every 10 to 15 days. If you need exact numbers for treatment decisions, a CGM is the right tool. If you want to learn which habits move you, direction is what you act on.

---

## FAQ

### What does the band actually measure?

The direction of your glucose: whether it's rising, holding steady or settling back down. It reads through the skin of your wrist. It doesn't give you an exact number in mmol/L or mg/dL the way a finger-prick meter or CGM does.

### How accurate is it?

In benchtop testing, the band classified about 80% of glucose trends correctly. We'll publish more results as testing continues.

### Is this a medical device?

No. GlucoSolutions is a wellness product. It is not intended to diagnose, treat, cure, or prevent any disease, and it is not a substitute for medical-grade glucose monitoring.

### Does it replace my doctor or dietitian?

No. It helps you learn which habits move your glucose in the right direction. Keep working with your care team, and bring what you learn to your appointments.

### Do I need a prescription?

No. The band and app will be available without a prescription.

### When can I get one, and what will it cost?

The band is in development. We'll invite people from the waitlist in small groups, starting in Canada. We haven't set a price yet; people on the waitlist will hear it first.

### iPhone or Android?

iPhone first. Android will follow.

### What happens to my data?

Your data is encrypted in transit and at rest, and we never sell it. You own it and can delete it at any time.

---

## Disclaimer

GlucoSolutions is a wellness product. It is not a medical device, is not intended to diagnose, treat, cure, or prevent any disease, and is not a substitute for medical-grade glucose monitoring or professional medical advice.
